ns2:course.label: Crop Growth and Management
ns2:course.description: Crop production and management as influenced by environment, plant species, and cropping system; relates plant growth processes to management practices. Prerequisite: NRES 201 and CPSC 112 or equivalent, or consent of instructor.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Prerequisite: NRES 201 and CPSC 112 or equivalent, or consent of instructor.
